items.title: Drawing a Nutcracker at the Table
items.alt: Blond boy in a blue sweatshirt drawing a plum-jacketed nutcracker beside a tin of colored pencils.
items.description: The boy studies a tall nutcracker standing beside his drawing. His pencil, open color tin and red trainers add small bright details around the plain wooden table.

items.title: Arranging a Nutcracker Display
items.alt: Older man in a maroon cardigan placing a blue nutcracker above two different figures on a wooden shelf.
items.description: The man steadies a blue toy on the upper shelf. A broad crowned king and a smaller red figure stand below, creating a display of three clearly different nutcrackers.

items.title: Hanging a Paper Nutcracker Garland
items.alt: Woman and boy tying a garland of three paper nutcrackers across a freestanding wooden frame.
items.description: A red cord carries three differently dressed paper nutcrackers between wooden posts. The boy holds one side while the woman ties the other, with both frame feet fully visible.

items.title: Nutcracker and Mouse King Puppet Theatre
items.alt: Small theatre with burgundy curtains, a blue nutcracker, crowned mouse and miniature Christmas tree.
items.description: Burgundy curtains open around a tiny tree between the nutcracker and crowned mouse. Gold scrollwork and complete turned legs give the tabletop theatre an ornate frame.

items.title: A Nutcracker Story Waltz
items.alt: Two dancers in plum and ivory costumes waltzing beside a small nutcracker on a decorated chest.
items.description: A plum skirt fans outward as the dancers turn together. Beside them, a small red nutcracker stands on a floral chest, linking the dance scene to the toy's story.

items.title: Girl with a Nutcracker beside the Tree
items.alt: Girl in a cream nightdress kneeling with a wooden nutcracker beside a decorated potted Christmas tree.
items.description: The girl gently steadies a tall toy on an oval rug. A potted fir tree, small wrapped parcel and red-and-gold ornaments surround the quiet Christmas scene.
